Third-Party Notices — skkugit-demo vendor/cutout
=================================================
Generated by inspecting node_modules/ as actually installed in this
prototype (package-lock.json pins the versions below) plus the bundled
license headers already shipped in vendor/cutout/worker.mjs.LEGAL.txt and
node_modules/@imgly/background-removal/ThirdPartyLicenses.json. Nothing
below is invented; each entry cites the file it was read from.

Top-level packages covered by this task:
  @imgly/background-removal  1.7.0   -> AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE-IMG-LY.txt,
                                        already present, not duplicated here)
  onnxruntime-web             1.21.0  -> MIT (see LICENSE-ONNX.txt)
  esbuild-wasm                0.25.12 -> MIT (dev dependency only, not
                                        shipped in the browser bundle)

Everything below is transitive dependencies of the above three, as
installed under node_modules/.

=====================================================================
GROUP 5 — Model weights (data/ directory, self-hosted, not from npm)
=====================================================================

  Runtime model files under vendor/cutout/data/ were downloaded from the
  IMG.LY-hosted CDN (https://staticimgly.com/@imgly/background-removal-
  data/1.7.0/dist/) and verified against the checksums pinned in this
  repo (see SOURCES.txt for exact pinned manifest reference). Per
  node_modules/@imgly/background-removal/ThirdPartyLicenses.json, the
  underlying CPU model architecture ("ISNET") traces to
  https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS, stated there as MIT-licensed. This
  task did not independently re-fetch DIS's own upstream LICENSE file to
  verify that MIT claim byte-for-byte (unlike the ONNX Runtime MIT text,
  which was pinned and fetched directly from a tagged commit) — see
  "Unresolved questions" below.

=====================================================================
Unresolved / open license questions (do not treat as settled)
=====================================================================
1. guid-typescript 1.0.9's ISC license lacks a shipped LICENSE file with
   an explicit copyright year/holder line; only "license": "ISC" and
   author "nicolas" are confirmed from package.json.
2. The "ISNET" model's MIT claim (https://github.com/xuebinqin/DIS) comes
   from @imgly's own ThirdPartyLicenses.json, not independently re-verified
   against DIS's own upstream repository LICENSE file in this session.
3. flatbuffers' and long's Apache-2.0 LICENSE files ship the standard
   Apache boilerplate without a filled-in "Copyright [yyyy] [name]" line;
   this notices file attributes them only via each package's own
   package.json "author" field, not a verified in-file copyright header.
4. @imgly/background-removal is AGPL-3.0 (see LICENSE-IMG-LY.txt, already
   present). This THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt file does not and cannot make
   the overall skkugit-demo app AGPL-compliant by itself — see
   SOURCES.txt for the compliance gate that must be cleared before any
   distribution or deployment of this prototype.
